objective: Independent PP-OpenNet-inspired packet time-length encoder benchmark on frozen Stage17 Email/Streaming protocols

execution.tmux_session: stage18_email_2022, stage18_email_2023, stage18_email_2024, stage18_streaming_2022, stage18_streaming_2023, stage18_streaming_2024

core_results.metric: E4_FULL Email Known Test Macro-F1 mean
E4_FULL Streaming Known Test Macro-F1 mean
E4_FULL overall UFAR at Known-Val P95
E4 minus E0 overall paired AUROC

limitations: Independent PP-OpenNet-inspired implementation; no verified official author code was available.
The frozen cache is capped at 30 packets rather than the paper's 1000-packet/two-second slices.
Only Email and Streaming Stage17 development protocols were available for this experiment.
Service labels are weak capture-activity labels and do not establish capture-disjoint generalization.
Background class, ARPL and PVRP were excluded to preserve the current Strict Unknown-Free boundary.
next_step: Do not start fusion; retain the negative result and preregister any future long-window or rejection-mechanism study separately.
